title: Burak Gülmez
text:
My research brings artificial intelligence and optimization together to solve real-world problems. I combine metaheuristic algorithms, multi-objective optimization and multi-criteria decision making with machine learning, deep learning and large language models to build explainable, practical decision-support tools for logistics and transportation, production scheduling, financial forecasting and portfolio optimization, medical image analysis, agriculture, and construction cost estimation.

Research keywords
Artificial intelligence Machine learning Deep learning Computer vision Large language models Metaheuristic algorithms Multi-objective optimization Multi-criteria decision making Operations research Logistics Transportation Big data Data mining Data science
